description: A neutral check of one agent hire on BNB Smart Chain, sealed on chain. Send the ERC-8183 job id. The deliverable the provider serves and its permanent copy on BNB Greenfield are fetched and hashed; the hash is compared with the pointer the provider wrote on chain at submission, the permanent copy with the served bytes and with the index; the parties, the time from funding to delivery, the amount paid and the settlement come from the chain. The claim states each check and its result, is hashed and sealed on opBNB from a dedicated key within about two minutes, and stays public. A hire that does not exist or has no deliverable yet is refused before any charge. One claim per hire and deliverable; a repeat check returns the claim on record. Price: 5 cents per call.

job.description: ERC-8183 job id on BNB Smart Chain, a positive whole number. Example: 1234
